mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, preventing degradation of catecholamines; bumetanide causes volume depletion and electrolyte abnormalities that potentiate sympathomimetic effects and increase risk of hypertensive crisis.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if combination necessary, monitor blood pressure closely, use lowest effective bumetanide dose, ensure adequate hydration/electrolyte replacement, and educate patient on hypertensive crisis symptoms.
